BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Online Form 2026 (32,388 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the notification for the TRE 4.0 recruitment of School Teacher posts on the official website of BPSC. As per the notification, the online application process for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 will start soon. Tentatively, there are a total of 32,388 vacancies that have been issued in the Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 for Middle School Teachers, Secondary Teachers, and Higher Secondary Teacher posts. Candidates must check the tentative details for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 September 2026
  • Last Date : Notify Soon
  • Fee Payment Last Date : Notify Soon
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
